csv_project_name: Design Services for 320 Main Street Parking Lot
csv_scope_of_work: The project scope includes design services for demolition of the existing buildings at 320 and 330 Main Street, and design of a new parking lot. New parking lot design will include demolition of existing buildings and other structures located at 320 and 330 Main Street, minor earthwork and grading, asphalt-concrete pavement, concrete and ADA improvements, parking lot striping, payment kiosk, vegetated bioswale and drainage improvements, solar lighting, landscaping and irrigation system, and EV-ready parking spaces. The design will also include a geotechnical investigation and report to characterize subsurface conditions and to support the vegetated bioswale and drainage improvements basis of design.
